chases.message: Hi Mina, three open items are blocking the October production pilot on the vendor procurement case, and all three are still unknown: cross-border transfers, personal information scope and subprocessors. Please confirm each one. For cross-border transfers, tell us whether personal data would move outside the current jurisdiction and where. For personal information scope, tell us which personal information is in scope. For subprocessors, tell us which third parties would process the data. The DPA is only a proposed position, not confirmed, and it is proposed as blocked until subprocessors and cross-border transfers are confirmed. A lead to check, not a confirmed fact, is 03_internal/internal_messages.txt. Also, the proposed rule that every response needs human approval before submission is unconfirmed, and nothing in this message approves or signs off any response.

Hi Parsa, chasing open items on the vendor-procurement case. Already known: the stated rule is that a human confirms customer-facing actions. Proposed, unconfirmed: OpenAI as primary inference, and payload capture intended OFF. Blockers for the October production pilot: we still need inference location and retention for prompts and responses. Also still open: evaluation, prompt injection, provenance, provider training retention, and tool actions. Please confirm the proposed OpenAI primary and payload-capture settings. Please also decide whether the Anthropic fallback is enabled (this is conditional on approval) and whether it is disabled for Acme if residency or legal requires it. Thanks.
Caveats: open decision (internal): Whether the Anthropic fallback is disabled for Acme if residency or legal requires it.; open decision (internal): Whether the Anthropic fallback is enabled, which is conditional on approval.

Hi Sam, the current insurance cover is recorded as CAD 5,000,000 (Cyber / Technology E&O), but it expires on 2026-10-01 and the renewal certificate is still pending. This is a blocker for the October production pilot. Please send us the renewed insurance certificate, or confirm the renewal date and expected coverage, so we can close this item before 2026-10-01.
Caveats: expires 2026-10-01; no evidence: Renewal of the current insurance certificate is pending.

Hello, we are following up on two open items for the vendor procurement case, and we do not yet have confirmed values for either. 1) Primary AWS region: please confirm the primary AWS region for this procurement. An April 2026 Canada overview document may be a lead to check, but it is not confirmed. 2) Vendor onboarding: please provide the current status of vendor onboarding and any details needed to complete it. Thank you.
